claims.statement: Template-created codespace work resides on a cloud VM rather than initially in a hosted repository. Saving and stopping permits later continuation; Git is typically installed and initialized except for the blank-template case. Local commits do not establish remote custody.

Deleting an unpublished codespace, including automatic deletion after the unused retention period, also deletes its work. The source recommends publishing to a hosted repository for persistence and collaboration; this conditional safeguard does not authorize publication or prove backup recoverability.

Publishing an unpublished codespace currently billed to an organization transfers codespace ownership and billing to the personal account. This is a consequential transition requiring scoped approval; the linked billing article remains separate evidence.

When Settings Sync is enabled in a codespace, settings updates move to a cloud cache and cloud updates from elsewhere enter the codespace. The conditional propagation is not a verified enabled setting or authorization to synchronize sensitive configuration.

The fragment opens the editor command palette using platform-specific shortcuts and selects the JSON user-settings command. This navigation procedure does not verify any setting or require changing it.

The prebuild-navigation fragment composes repository-navigation, repository-settings and planning/automation reusable dependencies before selecting Codespaces. Reading this fragment alone does not resolve every include, verify rendered navigation or confer repository-administration permission.

The comma and commented-line removal instruction applies within its surrounding devcontainer example. It is not a universal text edit for arbitrary JSON layouts; syntax and applicability must be checked before any mutation.

The example configures editor customizations with a spell-checking extension identifier for installation when the container is created. The identifier is illustrative rather than adopted policy; source text is not permission to install, and declaring an extension does not verify its execution or trustworthiness. The final resulting-file reference depends on surrounding content and chosen image.

The fragment links the external dev container property specification and optionally places a Dockerfile or compose.yaml beside devcontainer.json for experienced Docker users. It does not mandate Docker, prove successful configuration or execute upstream setup; linked specification and guide remain separate review dependencies.

Choosing the desktop editor requires that editor to be installed on the local machine. This conditional prerequisite is not an unconditional software mandate, an installation grant or proof of an installed application.
